info.title: Liforma Session Launch API
info.description: Server (API key) and browser (Origin allowlist) Session Launch endpoints used by @liforma/client. Public Zod schemas in api.liforma.ai (`sessionLaunchSchemas.ts`). Runtime bootstrap is an opaque signed `launch` string — not described here. API keys use `lfm_test_` / `lfm_live_` prefixes with scopes `sessions:create`, `sessions:read`, `experiences:read` by default.

parameters.description: Optional idempotency key. Same key + same body replays the prior Session Launch; same key + different body → 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.

Cache-Control.description: Required on every response containing launch.

bearerAuth.description: Developer API key from app.liforma.ai (`lfm_test_…` or `lfm_live_…`). Default scopes: sessions:create, sessions:read, experiences:read.

SessionCapabilities.description: Nested session capability flags exposed to integrators.

Session.description: Stable public session facts. Does not include transport, pipeline, renderer, or credentials.

SessionLaunchResponse.description: Public session plus opaque signed launch bootstrap for @liforma/client / player.liforma.ai. Integrators may transport `launch` but must not depend on its contents.

RuntimeSessionView.description: Persisted runtime session for GET / end. usage.seconds is a stub (0) until metering ships.

alreadyConverted.description: Conversion keys this play is already ineligible for (for example registration). Excluded from that key's conversion-rate denominator. Snapshot at mint; do not fire conversion() for these keys.

BrowserSessionRequest.description: Browser mint body. experienceId is typically exp_…; validated as a non-empty string (max 128).

alreadyConverted.description: Conversion keys this play is already ineligible for (for example registration). Excluded from that key's conversion-rate denominator. Snapshot at mint; do not fire conversion() for these keys.

AuthenticatedSessionRequest.description: Server mint body — browser fields plus optional processorId and host context (user, metadata, variables, initialState).

SessionConversionRequest.description: API-key trusted conversion. Unique per session+key. Does not create an org-wide definition. Allowed after the session has ended.
